title: Quadruple-μ4-CO3 2− bridged octanuclear dysprosium(III) compound showing single-molecule magnet behaviour

synthesis.procedure: Reaction of DyCl3·6H2O with H2L (1:1 ratio) in MeOH/CH2Cl2 (1:2 ratio) in the presence of triethylamine (5 equivalents) produces red crystals of [Dy8(μ4-CO3)4(L)8(H2O)8]·10MeOH·2H2O (1). Atmospheric CO2 is trapped as carbonate in basic medium and templates the octanuclear assembly. Yield 34%.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: solution reaction with atmospheric CO2 fixation
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: red crystals of 1 obtained from MeOH/CH2Cl2

properties.summary: Octanuclear Dy8 SMM. Room-temperature χMT = 106.4 cm3 K mol−1 (expected 113.36 for eight uncoupled DyIII). χMT decreases to 98.1 cm3 K mol−1 at 30 K then rises to 127.3 cm3 K mol−1 at 2 K, indicating intramolecular ferromagnetic interactions. Magnetization 42.6 μB at 1.9 K and 7 T without saturation; non-superimposed M vs H/T curves indicate anisotropy. Zero-field ac susceptibility shows slow relaxation. Cole–Cole α = 0.08–0.13 (1.9–8 K). Thermally activated Orbach relaxation above 8.0 K with Ueff = 74.2 K and τ0 ≈ 2.1 × 10−6 s; temperature-independent quantum regime at lower T with τ ≈ 0.2 s. Butterfly-shaped hysteresis observed at 1.9 K on a conventional SQUID magnetometer.
